evals.prompt: I have a wuxia novel I want to turn into short videos, about 30,000 characters, help me get started
evals.expected_output: Should trigger video-workflow: the project was created in the Web UI and the session is bound to the project root; call get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan; confirm content mode and generation mode from project.json; guide the user to upload the whole source in the Web UI or register it via upload_source; do not read the novel text directly

assertions.name: queries_workflow_plan
assertions.text: Calls mcp__arcreel__get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan and proceeds per next_action (collect_project_input)

assertions.name: reads_modes_from_project
assertions.text: Confirms the already-set content_mode and generation_mode from project.json, without asking the user or trying to change them

assertions.name: asks_for_source_upload
assertions.text: Asks the user to upload the whole source in the Web UI, or register it via mcp__arcreel__upload_source

assertions.name: does_not_create_project
assertions.text: Does not create a project directory or write initial project.json fields

assertions.name: does_not_read_novel
assertions.text: Does not read the novel text directly into context

evals.prompt: Continue the last project, I remember the character analysis is already done, help me continue
evals.expected_output: Should trigger video-workflow, call get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan, and continue from the corresponding action per next_action

assertions.name: queries_workflow_plan
assertions.text: Calls mcp__arcreel__get_workflow_plan for the authoritative plan

assertions.name: does_not_infer_stage
assertions.text: Does not read project.json or probe the filesystem with Glob to infer the stage itself

assertions.name: executes_next_action
assertions.text: Executes the corresponding controlled action per the next_action returned by the plan

evals.prompt: Regenerate the storyboard images for episode 2, I'm not happy with the visuals of E2S03 and E2S07
evals.expected_output: Should use generate-storyboard: find episode 2's script file in the project's episodes[], call generate_storyboards with segment_ids naming only these two shots for regeneration, and after generation dispatch review-images to review the images and hand the conclusions to the user for confirmation

assertions.name: uses_segment_ids
assertions.text: Calls mcp__arcreel__generate_storyboards with segment_ids naming only E2S03 and E2S07, not regenerating everything

assertions.name: resolves_episode_script
assertions.text: script takes that episode's script file in episodes[] (episode_{集 ID}.json), finding the episode by its airing position, not treating "episode 2" directly as the episode ID

assertions.name: reviews_regenerated_images
assertions.text: After generation completes, dispatches the review-images subagent to review the images and hands the report and recommendations to the user for confirmation; does not regenerate or edit again before confirmation

assertions.name: no_bash_scripts
assertions.text: Does not generate storyboard images by calling python scripts or command-line arguments via Bash

evals.prompt: Video generation for this episode broke off halfway, help me pick it back up
evals.expected_output: Should call get_generation_batch to query the durable batch and decide the next step per problem.action: resend only IDs whose action is retry, with selected scope and force=false; wait for the results of wait_for_task IDs; do not directly resend IDs that need handling first such as fix_input; already-enqueued tasks run as usual and are not resent

assertions.name: resends_remaining_ids
assertions.text: After calling mcp__arcreel__get_generation_batch to query the batch, resends only IDs whose problem.action is retry; IDs with other actions such as wait_for_task or fix_input are not resent directly

assertions.name: uses_selected_scope
assertions.text: Uses target.scope=selected when resending

assertions.name: does_not_force_resume
assertions.text: Explicitly uses force=false when resending, not automatically forcing redo of in-flight tasks

assertions.name: does_not_regenerate_all
assertions.text: Does not regenerate completed or already-enqueued video units, and does not suggest the user rerun the whole batch

evals.prompt: All the videos for episode 1 are generated, cut a version for me and render a final cut when done
evals.expected_output: Should use edit-video: determine the episode's edit timeline (create one from the script if none), after reading dispatch review-footage for the first-round full review, edit with one batch of edit_timeline operations, deliver the change summary and jump links, then call render_final_cut as the user asked to render the final cut

assertions.name: reads_before_edit
assertions.text: Before modifying, calls mcp__arcreel__read_timeline to get the revision and uses it as the base_revision of mcp__arcreel__edit_timeline

assertions.name: reviews_footage_first_round
assertions.text: In the first-round edit, dispatches the read-only review-footage subagent to review every video unit used by the timeline, and picks versions and sets trims per the reports

assertions.name: summarizes_changes
assertions.text: At the end of an edit round, summarizes the changes and reasons by clip number

assertions.name: renders_on_request
assertions.text: The user asked for a final cut, so calls mcp__arcreel__render_final_cut, and explains warning-level issues before submitting

assertions.name: no_ffmpeg_scripts
assertions.text: Does not stitch videos by calling ffmpeg or scripts via Bash
